summary: The 'Student' entity is a central object representing student records and operations in the HSPnet system, including profile management, consent, demographics, program assignments, document uploads, system user account control, prerequisite tracking, and business rule enforcement.
purpose: To manage all aspects of student information, interactions, and workflows: searching, adding, updating, deleting, profile formatting, consent/document management, IT provisioning, demographic updates, and various validations for educational placements and system access.

workflows.name: Student Search
steps: Input agencyID, lastName, firstName, studentNumber, and optional filters.
Search procedure retrieves student records, supports pagination and advanced filtering.
Return results with formatted fields and status.

workflows.name: Student Add/Update
steps: Input student data (including consent info, demographics, contact details, etc).
If duplicate detected (matching student or confidentiality form), update existing record with new consent/confidentiality info.
Else, insert new student record and associated fields.
Perform validation checks (last name, first name, student number required).

workflows.name: Student Profile Formatting
steps: Display formatted names, status tags (Graduated, Removed, Waived), profile expiration (icon), and document upload status.
Provide formatted tooltips and update details.
Restrict name visibility if consent expired and user is not sysadmin.

workflows.name: Student Consent & Expiry
steps: Store consent date and program.
Calculate expiration based on business constants (6 years, 180 days threshold, warning periods).
Hide name/email/gender if consent expired and not sysadmin; update or un-expire consent as needed.

workflows.name: Student Demographics Management
steps: Update demographics via stored procedure.
Store citizenship/ethnicity codes and notes.
Expose alternate language fields where applicable.

workflows.name: Student Document/Requirements Handling
steps: Upload and check for student documents.
Return profile/requirement status icons (expired, document, gender missing, eTopic).

workflows.name: User Account Management
steps: Create/disable/manage student user accounts (key icon logic, sysadmin privilege).
Allow user account creation if consent program present and name is not initials only.

business_rules: Student record requires LastName, FirstName, StudentNumber to be valid.
Consent expires after 6 years, with expiration threshold/warning periods.
If consent expired, and user is not system admin, hide names, email, gender.
Duplicate check: If multiple students/confidentiality forms, update instead of insert.
Icons (expired, document, gender warning, eTopic) only shown if sufficient profile information.
Can only create user account if consent program present and name is not initials only.
Student search restricts results to program if specified; empty search returns empty list.
PhoneIsMobile, AltPhoneIsMobile, AltPhone2IsMobile set based on phone string.
validations: Consent date must be valid and not null.
Check for duplicate by StudentID and confidentiality form.
Search criteria must have at least one value (last name, first name, student number, consent date).
calculations: Consent expiration based on date and business constants.
Profile formatting based on name, status, consent, document presence.
conditions: If consent expired and user is not sysadmin: Hide student names, email, gender.
If duplicate found: Update confidentiality details instead of insert.
Document or gender icons: Only shown if fields present and not expired.
system_behavior: Profile formatting adapts to consent status and user privilege.
Short-lived caching mechanisms for search results.
Student add/update/deletion via stored procedures; always checks for duplicates and required fields.
Workflow steps exposed as methods with parameters validated before DB interaction.
Support for alternate language fields where applicable (citizenship, ethnicity, gender).
dependencies: Database procedures (StudentAdd, StudentUpdate, StudentSearch, StudentDelete, etc)
exceptions: Missing required fields add error messages and prevent database update.
Duplicate records handled by confidentially form update logic.
